reviewer: Claude (2026-10-25), visual spot review of the contact sheets; frames at 25, 50 and 75 percent of each completion video

families.locomotion (00, 01): Real-game observer views in the Dunwall tower room. The partner stands armed, walks and runs: upright idle, stride and run poses, feet planted between segments.
families.traversal (08): Window climb and ledge pull-up with the body over the sill, low vault, slide.
families.combat (11, 14): Blocks and parries in the tower room, street fights with several guards in Karnaca. Deaths and knockdowns with whole-body falls, a stun-mine flash, a guard knocked to the floor.
families.items (16): Pistol drawn and aimed at the docks, crossbow and grenade gestures, held items in hand.
families.takedowns (18, 20): Lethal and non-lethal takedowns paired with a guard, from behind and the front. A choke hold, the guard lowered to the floor, an aerial drop onto a guard.
families.powers (27, 28): Corvo's cast poses (Bend Time, Swarm, Possession, Windblast), dimly lit but readable. Emily's Dark Vision hand to face, Domino gestures, the Doppelganger clone, Far Reach with the beam from her hand.
families.interactions and scenes (33, 37): Lever and crank turns at the Karnaca pump, pickups at a desk and a table, a scripted scene's first-person view (Emily's face in the opening), the native pose handoff after it.

issues: None that contradict an item's recorded verdict. Some power and night frames are dark, and three frames per video do not show timing or blending; those rest on the recorded per-video verdicts.
notReviewedHere: 27 of the 39 sheets; recheck summary.json covers every video mechanically (exists, at least 1 s, at least 320 px).
